# JSG Construction Limited

> Residential master builders in Dublin, Ireland. Home extensions, full
> renovations and structural steel, built by an in-house crew under RIAI
> contracts and BCAR.

Email: commercial@jsgconstruction.ie
Site visits: Monday to Friday.

## What the company does

- House extensions, single and two-storey.
- Full renovations, back-to-brick modernisation of period Dublin homes.
- Structural steel, RSJ knock-throughs and open-plan conversions, engineered
  and certified.

## Where it builds

Dublin city and county, including South Dublin, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown and
Fingal, and the neighbouring counties of Kildare and Wicklow. Areas named on
earlier material include Ranelagh, Blackrock, Dalkey, Malahide and Howth.

## Facts that can be quoted

- Public liability cover: €6.5M, on every project.
- In-house craftsmen: 8. A permanent crew rather than a subcontractor chain.
- Compliance: BCAR and RIAI on every build.
- Pricing: itemised in writing after a site visit, before any contract.

## What the company does not publish

No telephone number, no founding date and no count of completed projects,
because none of them has been confirmed for publication. County Meath appeared
on earlier material and is left out here until it is confirmed. Everything
above can be checked against the site itself.
